concerns.text: FR‑047 requires the pipeline to abort when a species has < 50 retained samples after series‑level filtering, but no task implements this abort‑on‑insufficient‑samples check.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 2 – User Story 2 – Quantitative Evaluation Against STRING (US‑2)
concerns.text: FR‑048 mandates a pilot‑benchmark on a held‑out dataset and the generation of `pilot_validation_<species>.json` for construct‑validity justification; no task creates this benchmark or artifact.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 2 – User Story 2 – Quantitative Evaluation Against STRING (US‑2) – T083
concerns.text: FR‑045 states edge inclusion is based **solely** on the correlation threshold (≥ 0.75). Task T083 (Benjamini‑Hochberg FDR correction) and its unit test T083c filter edges by adjusted p‑value ≤ 0.05 before writing the edge list, directly weakening FR‑045.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 2 – User Story 2 – Quantitative Evaluation Against STRING (US‑2)
concerns.text: FR‑045 also requires a `correlation_stats_<species>.tsv` file recording adjusted p‑values; no task creates or validates this file.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 2 – User Story 2 – Quantitative Evaluation Against STRING (US‑2) – T043
concerns.text: Tasks reference FR‑043 (skip GEO series with < 30 samples) but FR‑043 does not exist in the specification, causing a traceability mismatch.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 2 – User Story 2 – Quantitative Evaluation Against STRING (US‑2) – T114
concerns.text: Tasks reference FR‑046, which is also absent from the spec, creating another traceability inconsistency.
FR‑014 requires batch‑effect correction and abort if residual batch variance > 5 %; the tasks implement correction but lack any verification or abort step for the > 5 % residual variance condition.

Constitution Principle II (Verified Accuracy) demands that citation validation enforce a title‑token‑overlap ≥ 0.7. The citation‑validation tasks do not mention this quantitative overlap check, risking a constitutional violation.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 6 – Sensitivity Analysis & Supporting Tasks – T045c
concerns.text: SC‑001 in the spec requires AUPRC ≥ 0.70 (and AUROC ≥ 0.70) for each species. The CI step T045c only asserts AUPRC ≥ 0.65, weakening the success criterion.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 3 – User Story 3 – Functional Enrichment (US‑3) – T044
concerns.text: SC‑002 mandates at least one GO term with adjusted p < 0.05 per species. CI step T044 passes when no significant term is found (only checks file format), thereby violating the acceptance criterion.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 2 – User Story 2 – Quantitative Evaluation Against STRING (US‑2) – T083c
concerns.text: The unit test T083c enforces that edges are filtered by adjusted p ≤ 0.05 before writing the edge list, which conflicts with FR‑045’s ‘solely threshold‑based’ edge selection rule.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 2 – User Story 2 – Quantitative Evaluation Against STRING (US‑2) – T083
concerns.text: Introducing optional FDR‑based edge filtering (`--fdr` flag) creates a staged simplification not reflected in the spec; the spec does not allow staging for this FR, so this is a retroactive narrowing of the functional requirement.
